stories.title: Etsy Cracks Down on AI-Generated Content to Protect Buyers from Barrage of Slop
stories.label: technology
stories.summary: Etsy just put new rules in place to stop a flood of AI-generated knockoffs from crowding out real handmade goods on its site. The move protects nearly 6 million small artisan sellers who rely on the platform to make a living from their actual craftsmanship. It also means shoppers can trust that what they're buying is genuinely made by a person, not a computer pretending to be one. It's a simple, concrete step that puts real people and real work first.
stories.why_good: A real policy change already enacted that protects the livelihoods of millions of small sellers and restores trust for shoppers, with no political angle.

stories.title: New Texas School Is Named For Longtime Janitor 'Miss Marilyn'
stories.label: people
stories.summary: A Texas school district just named a brand-new school after Marilyn Hampton, a custodian who spent her career quietly keeping the halls clean and the kids cared for. It's a rare honor, usually reserved for superintendents or donors, but the community decided her decades of steady, loving service deserved the spotlight. Watching her reaction when she found out is the kind of moment that reminds you how much everyday kindness matters. It's a simple, heartfelt way of saying thank you to someone who gave so much without ever asking for recognition.
stories.why_good: A real, completed act of community recognition for a person's lifetime of quiet service -- uplifting, not political, no suffering at its core.

stories.title: Best Spud Harvest in a Decade Clears the Gloom of Crops Failing from Scorching Summer
stories.label: agriculture
stories.summary: After a rough summer that damaged many crops, Japan's potato farmers just had their best harvest in ten years. A perfect mix of rain and temperatures lined up at just the right time, giving growers a much-needed win. It's a reminder that even with a changing climate throwing curveballs, good growing seasons still happen. For farmers who've been worried about their livelihoods, this is a real breath of relief.
stories.why_good: A concrete, verified bumper harvest that actually happened, bringing tangible relief to farmers without any political framing.
